audio_file.description: Relative path such as audio/file.mp3. May be null for non-TTS messages.

origin.description: Return address declared by the publisher, with serverHost/reach/attested stamped by the server. Added 2026-07-29 so a listener can answer the agent that published a message instead of guessing from global config. Permitted by this schema's own additionalProperties:true; documented here so it stops being invisible. NOT in the top-level `required` list, and deliberately so: since 2026-08-04 every publish path REFUSES a record without one (see checkOriginInput in src/origin.ts), but ~100 records predate that rule and must keep validating and rendering. Required on write, optional on read — the asymmetry is the point, not an oversight.

target.description: Discriminated on multiplexer. tmux carries session (durable); herdr carries workspace+pane and label, where label is the handle that survives a herdr restart and pane is not.

serverHost.description: Stamped by the server. Never accepted from the caller.

reach.description: The server's verdict on answerability, not the publisher's claim.

attested.description: self-declared means nothing verified the publisher's claim about its own location. A listener must be shown this.
